callees.name: _extraction_ident
callees.pre_condition: name and qualified_name are string values obtained from a codegraph nodes table row.
callees.post_condition: Returns a class-qualified, canonicalized function identifier string using '::' as the component separator.

callees.name: _fqn_for
callees.pre_condition: file_path is a relative source file path string. deduped is a canonicalized, deduplicated function identifier string.
callees.post_condition: Returns the fully-qualified name string for the function, combining the file-path-derived components and the deduplicated identifier with '::' separators.
